profile.headline: Senior Product Engineer | AI-Native Products | Full Stack, Mobile & Backend | UI Craftsmanship & Product Design Focus
profile.summary:
I’m a product-minded software engineer who enjoys turning ideas into products that people actually use.

Over the course of my career, I’ve worked across frontend, backend, mobile, and cloud infrastructure, leading projects from concept to launch. Rather than focusing on a single layer of the stack, I enjoy owning the entire product lifecycle - understanding user needs, designing solutions, building scalable systems, and delivering polished user experiences.

One area that consistently differentiates my work is a strong focus on product craftsmanship. I care deeply about the details that make software feel intuitive, fast, and delightful to use. While I’m not a designer by title, I often work closely with design and bring a high level of attention to interaction design, visual polish, usability, and overall user experience. I believe great products are built when engineering quality and design quality are treated with equal importance.

My experience spans consumer and enterprise products, cross-functional collaboration, and shipping features in fast-moving environments. I thrive in ambiguous spaces where technical execution, product thinking, and business impact intersect.

Recently, I’ve become particularly interested in AI-native products and developer tools. I enjoy leveraging modern AI capabilities to build software that helps people learn, work, and make better decisions.

Areas of focus:
• Product Engineering
• AI-Native Product Development
• Full-Stack Development
• UI Craftsmanship & Design Systems
• System Design & Architecture

I’m always interested in connecting with builders, founders, and teams creating products that users genuinely love.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Wearables in Reality Labs
- Built core UX and experiences for future augmented reality glasses (C++).
- Worked on app launcher, multitasking, widgets, AI-first UX on the split compute environment.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
App ads (Advantage+ App Campaigns) Product
- Served as product tech lead building into Ads Manager, the world's largest React application, used by advertisers promoting mobile apps (React, PHP/Hack).
- Worked on improving Advantage+ App Campaigns product experience - dynamic creative optimization, suggested ads, split testing, in-product guidance, app settings, automation<>manual product unification.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Fire TV Personalization
- Designed and developed distributed backend systems and neural network models powering the personalized Fire TV browsing experience.
- Worked on row ranking strategy experiments to maximize customer engagement.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Digital Content and Commerce Services
- Developed a self-service financial event aggregation and publishing platform for Amazon digital businesses, fulfilling business accounting requirements and serving tens of millions of requests per day.
- Developed a data ingestion pipeline and configuration-based data parsing and transformation workflows.
- Developed an accounting data reconciliation system and an exception classification and reprocessing framework.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Tizen Platform UI & Graphics Framework
- Developed the OpenGL ES rendering backend for Tizen UI rendering framework.
- Worked as an Enlightenment Foundation Libraries (EFL) open source committer.
- Participated in the launch of multiple Samsung Gear series devices.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Tizen Platform UI & Graphics Framework
- Developed the OpenGL ES rendering backend for Tizen UI rendering framework.
- Worked on the specification of new graphical rendering interfaces (EGL) between OpenGL ES and the Tizen platform native window system.
- Participated in the launch of multiple Samsung Gear series and mobile devices.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Mobile UI Engine Development
- Developed embedded 2D/3D GUI engine optimized for Linux, Windows-based mobile devices with OpenGL ES and OpenVG hardware acceleration.
- Developed shader-based 3D effects for next-generation GUI.
